cause: Both eac79ca and current renderer append name and count only. The real-render test dereferences absent .pop-provider-chev before its visibility assertions. The collapse contract is aria-controls, aria-expanded, panel.hidden and caller-owned expanded Set.
proposedChange: Keep every original check and meaningful assertion; replace invalid decorative caret assertion with controlled-panel layout visibility. Add one native mouse collapse-expand check per theme/width (8 new checks).
